The separate model condition therefore does not specify the thermodynamic link needed for that interpretation.

Step 1.2 concludes objectivity from Bingham graph equivariance [F6], but [F6] gives only $\mathcal B(QDQ^{\mathsf T})=Q\mathcal B(D)Q^{\mathsf T}$. It does not establish that the strain rate transforms as $D^*=QDQ^{\mathsf T}$ under the observer change. That kinematic fact is available in [F5] and is used in step 1.1, so this is a small, readily closed proof gap; step 1.2 does not cite or invoke it.
